responsibilities.quote: Staff and students of Trinity College Dublin, when using AI and GenAI, must do so in ways that are appropriate, transparent, responsible and prioritise ethical considerations
All staff and students must uphold the principles of academic integrity (including the appropriate use of GenAI) and adhere to the regulations as outlined by the University.
All staff and students must inform themselves about academic integrity and the General Regulations that pertain to academic integrity (including the appropriate use of GenAI)
Students must read and understand the Library Guide on Academic Integrity and complete the Ready, Steady, Write plagiarism tutorial, as specified by Trinity.
Students should familiarise themselves with the Library Guide on Generative AI,
